fjoin

Source: R/fjoin-package.R
fjoin-package.Rd

fjoin is a general-purpose data frame join package that runs on data.table and works seamlessly in general workflows and tidyverse pipelines. It is lightweight, fast, and has short and clear syntax with options not found in other frameworks.

Vignettes

Visit the package website https://trobx.github.io/fjoin or access locally in R:

  • Guide to fjoin: vignette("fjoin")

  • Performance overview: vignette("fjoin-performance")
